=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:121 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: In `review_phase_deadline_extension_allowed`, line 121 (`if [ -n "${REVIEW_RUNNER_WAIT_RUN_ID:-}" ] && ! [[ "$ext_run_id" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then return 0; fi`) keeps the deadline extended for any number of consecutive empty runs lookups, because `RUN_ID="unknown"` (lines 521-523) never closes the stretch (lines 870-873 need a numeric `RUN_ID`); only the ceiling check at line 115 stops it.
  WHY: An empty lookup that lasts (for example a GitHub API outage that is not a rate limit, or the run dropping out of the per_page=100 / leg-(b) filter) used to exit at once with `status=timeout`; now it polls for up to REVIEW_TIMEOUT (60 minutes by default) and then exits through lines 923-929 with a false `status=no_review_triggered` ("No review workflow run ... ever appeared"), which goes against the #9480 Non-goals; the test `test_phase4_runner_wait_survives_an_empty_runs_lookup_past_base_deadline` covers only one empty poll. The reviewer marked this NIT, recorded here as low.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:354 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Possible regression in runner-wait stretch handling: the fix relies on REVIEW_RUNNER_WAIT_RUN_ID staying set.
  WHY: If the variable is cleared unexpectedly, or the polling loop does not keep the stretch across transient failures, the deadline-ceiling branch error reporting (lines 364-374) might be skipped or report misleading errors; the reviewer called the logic complex and prone to future regressions. The reviewer gave no severity; low is a placeholder.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:854 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The inactivity timer (LAST_ACTIVITY and IDLE) is reset only when review_waiting_for_runner returns 0 (line 858), so a poll that cannot read the jobs JSON during an open runner-wait stretch does not reset it.
  WHY: A long run of failed poll reads during a runner wait can let the inactivity timer expire and raise a "Review phase stalled" error even when the run was really waiting for a runner and the failures were transient; the reviewer says this is the behaviour the plan intended. The reviewer gave no severity; low is a placeholder.
